displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 65 is 6 short and 5 long
meaning: DC volts low, speed limiting. Supply voltage is under 197 V, or a loose wire or the inverter is limiting compressor speed. The table does not list a reset time.
causes: Low supply line voltage, under 197 V
Loose wire in the control box
diySteps: Count 6 short flashes and 5 long flashes. Do not use code 46's approximately 180 V figure on this row. This row says under 197 V
Technician: check supply voltage to the outdoor unit and contact the utility if it is low. Check for a loose wire in the unit. Replace the inverter if the damage is internal
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Measuring line voltage at the outdoor unit is not a homeowner check.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
